name: cairn
description: Agent-driven SDLC: discover, PRD, phased parallel plan, build, check, review, ship. Script-owned state per plan and fresh-eyes checks before the PRD.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, build, review and ship with plan state owned by a CLI
interface.longDescription: cairn runs a feature or a fix through discover, PRD, plan, build, check, review and ship. A CLI owns each plan's state and refuses a step whose proof is missing; agents do the judgment work. In Codex, approvals are typed by you in your own terminal.
defaultPrompt: Show the status of my cairn plans
